marketplace_summary: A captivating audio guide to Botticelli's Birth of Venus — suitable for all ages.

descriptions.text: Venus rises from the sea on a shell, blown ashore by the winds Zephyr and Aura, as a Hora holds out a flowered cloak.
Notice the idealized, elongated figure — Botticelli draws on classical antiquity while imbuing the scene with a dreamlike quality.

marketplace_summary: In-depth technical analysis of da Vinci's Annunciation for art history enthusiasts.

descriptions.text: Leonardo employs an unusual low viewpoint and aerial perspective to create spatial depth, while the angel's wings echo those in earlier Florentine tradition.
The Virgin's right hand rests on a lectern with intricate marble inlay — a showcase of Leonardo's early mastery of foreshortening.

marketplace_summary: Child-friendly story about Mantegna's Lamentation of Christ.

descriptions.text: This painting shows Jesus lying down after the crucifixion, with his friends crying around him. The painter used a special trick to make Jesus' feet look very big!

marketplace_summary: Medium-level guide connecting the Last Supper copy in Brera to Leonardo's original.

descriptions.text: Painted by Giampietrino around 1520, this full-scale copy preserves details — like the feet of the apostles — lost in Leonardo's deteriorated original.
Comparing copies like this one is essential for restoration work: it informed the 1999 restoration of Leonardo's mural at Santa Maria delle Grazie.
